item.title: President Pezeshkian congratulates Turkiye on Republic Day
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — President Masoud Pezeshkian has extended congratulations to his Turkish counterpart, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, on the occasion of Turkiye’s national day, reaffirming Tehran’s readiness to expand cooperation with Ankara to advance mutual interests and strengthen regional stability and security.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA — President Masoud Pezeshkian has extended congratulations to his Turkish counterpart, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, on the occasion of Turkiye’s national day, reaffirming Tehran’s readiness to expand cooperation with Ankara to advance mutual interests and strengthen regional stability and security.

item.title: 'Surrender' does not exist in Iranian nation’s lexicon: Commander
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The enemies of the Islamic Republic failed to achieve their goals in their recent war of aggression, emphasizing that “surrender” has no place in the lexicon of the Iranian nation, says Deputy Chief of the Iranian Army for Coordination Rear Admiral Habibollah Sayyari.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz reality determined on ground: IRGC spokesperson
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC), has said that developments in the Strait of Hormuz are determined in the air, on land and at sea, not on social media or in the US’s media war rooms.

item.title: Exclusive | Iranian Navy carried out more than 20 operations against US warships: Commander
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Naval forces of the Iranian Army carried out more than 20 operations against US warships during the 40-day conflict that began on February 28, while approximately 300 additional operations targeted American interests in various locations, including through missile and drone strikes, the coordinating deputy of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army Navy has said.

item.title: Putin praises martyred Leader’s role in founding Gas Exporting Countries Forum
item.description: Speaking at the 8th Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF) Summit in Moscow on Tuesday (October 27), Russian President Vladimir Putin welcomed remarks by his Iranian counterpart, Masoud Pezeshkian, on the need for GECF member states to collectively counter unilateral sanctions. Putin said the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, had played a major role in establishing the forum.

item.title: Ayatollah Khamenei outlines priorities on economy, national unity, ending war

item.title: Hezbollah chief says Iran prioritizes ending Israeli attacks on Lebanon
